CREATE TABLE EDS.GENERAL_LEDGER_FACT
WITH    
(   
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH(CIF_ID)
            ,   HEAP
            ,   PARTITION   (   [AS_OF_DATE] RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES
                                (
									'2024-03-01', '2024-04-01', '2024-05-01', '2024-06-01', '2024-07-01', '2024-08-01', '2024-09-01', '2024-10-01', '2024-11-01', '2024-12-01', '2025-01-01', '2025-02-01', '2025-03-01', '2025-04-01', '2025-05-01', '2025-06-01', '2025-07-01', '2025-08-01', '2025-09-01', '2025-10-01', '2025-11-01', '2025-12-01'
								)

                            )

)
AS
SELECT 

	CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE 
,	GAM.[ACID]  AS GAM_ACID 
,	GAM.[BANK_ID] AS GAM_BANK_ID

,	GAM.[FREZ_REASON_CODE_2]
,	GAM.[FREZ_REASON_CODE_3]
,	GAM.[FREZ_REASON_CODE_4]
,	GAM.[FREZ_REASON_CODE_5]

,	GAM.[preferred_caI_base]
,	GAM.[PREFERRED_CAL_BASE]
,	GAM.[ADDITIONAL_CAL_BASE]
,	GAM.[MUD_POOL_ACCT_FLG]
,	GAM.[ALT1_ACCT_SHORT_NAME]
,	GAM.[ALT1_ACCT_NAME]

,	GAM.[ACCT_MOD_FLG]
,	GAM.[WTAX_FLOOR_LIMIT_FREQ]
,	GAM.[CHQ_PROV_BY_BANK_FLG]
,	GAM.[CHQ_VAL_PRD_MNTH]
,	GAM.[CHQ_VAL_PRD_DAY]
,	GAM.[WTAX_WAIVER_LEVEL]
,	GAM.[WTAX_APPLICABLE_LEVEL]
,	GAM.[WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE]
,	GAM.[WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE]
,	GAM.[WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE]
,	GAM.[TAX_CERT_NUM]
,	GAM.[TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS]
,	GAM.[TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE]
,	GAM.[ACCT_OWNERSHIP_XFER_AGE]
,	GAM.[OD_PROT_ALWD]
,	GAM.[PYMNT_REF_NUM]
,	GAM.[RA_REF_NUM]
,	GAM.[REQ_MIN_DIS_AMT]
,	GAM.[REQ_MIN_DIS_TENOR]
,	GAM.[DISP_BLOCK_AMT]
,	GAM.[CONS_BAL_FLG]
,	GAM.[TAX_EVENT]
,	GAM.[REQUESTED_BY]
,	GAM.[TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE]
,	GAM.[DR_INT_PRENOTE_REQ_FLG]
,	GAM.[DR_INT_PRENOTE_PERIOD]
,	GAM.[CHRG_PRENOTIFICATION_FLG]
,	GAM.[TARGET_BAL_FOR_SWEEPS]
,	GAM.[CHECK_FUNDS_AVAIL_SET]
,	GAM.[RULE_SET_ID]
,	GAM.[CHQ_REORDER_ALWD_FLG]
,	GAM.[DR_INT_METHOD]
,	GAM.[COLL_CHRG_FOR_SWP_REG]
,	GAM.[SWP_CHRG_COLL_ACCT_FLG]
,	GAM.[SSA_PLAN_ID]
,	GAM.[ESCH_CR_BACID]
,	GAM.[LAST6_ACCT_NUM] AS GAM_LAST6_ACCT_NUM
,	GAM.[LAST6_FORACID]
,	LEFT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 5) AS GAM_BNK_CODE 
,	RIGHT(LEFT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS GAM_SOURCE_CODE 
,	GAM.FILE_NAME AS GAM_FILE_NAME 
,	GAM.insert_dttm AS GAM_INSERT_DTTM 
,	LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS GAM_BUSINESS_DATE 

------EAB------
,	EAB.[ACID] AS EAB_ACID 
,	EAB.[EOD_DATE]
,	EAB.BANK_ID AS EAB_BANK_ID 
,	EAB.[TRAN_DATE_BAL]
,	EAB.[TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
,	EAB.[VALUE_DATE_BAL]
,	EAB.[VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
,	EAB.[END_EOD_DATE]
,	EAB.[LCHG_USER_ID] AS EAB_LCHG_USER_ID 
,	EAB.[LCHG_TIME] AS EAB_LCHG_TIME
,	EAB.[RCRE_USER_ID] AS EAB_RCRE_USER_ID
,	EAB.[RCRE_TIME] AS EAB_RCRE_TIME
,	EAB.[TS_CNT] AS EAB_TS_CNT
,	EAB.[EAB_CRNCY_CODE] AS EAB_CRNCY_CODE
,	LEFT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 5) AS EAB_BNK_CODE 
,	RIGHT(LEFT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS EAB_SOURCE_CODE 
,	EAB.FILE_NAME AS EAB_FILE_NAME 
,	EAB.insert_dttm AS EAB_INSERT_DTTM 
,	LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS EAB_BUSINESS_DATE 
,	EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL AS RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE 

----CONVERSION----
,CAST(0 AS numeric(22,4)) AS BILLED_AMOUNT
,CAST(SANCT_LIM AS numeric(22,4)) CREDIT_LIMIT
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL
    ELSE EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate
    END AS numeric(22,4)) RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
,CAST(0 AS numeric(22,4)) AS BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN GAM.SANCT_LIM
    ELSE GAM.SANCT_LIM * BCC.ConversionRate
    END AS numeric(22,4)) CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 1
    ELSE BCC.ConversionRate
    END AS numeric(22,4)) CONVERSION_RATE


FROM (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_GLD_GENACCTMASTTABLE WHERE H = 'D') GAM
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE WHERE H = 'D') EAB 
ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
AND LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8)
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.currencyconversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' )  BCC ON 
LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
AND GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
WHERE 1=2
